title: PRI-PRE-001 evidence: DPIA required but missing
description: Structural measurability check only: a DPIA status, and a non-empty evidence identifier once that status is approved. This does not assess whether the DPIA itself is adequate -- see docs/governance-contract.md and the control's own ASSESSMENT.md. Independent of this control's existing Azure Policy demo (infra/policy-definition.bicep), which evaluates deployment-request tags directly and never reads this file.

version.description: Only the currently implemented evidence-shape version is accepted. A future breaking change to this control's evidence shape bumps this const, not a version registry.

dpiaStatus.description: Structural declaration only; approval authenticity is not verified here.

dpiaEvidenceId.description: Opaque reference to the DPIA record in the organization's own privacy/records system. No embedded line breaks.
